subject: Locust Street Board of Appeals Decision Appeal
overview: The City Council voted to appeal a Board of Appeals decision on the Locust Street development in Land Court and deferred over $1.1 million in end-of-year budget transfers until more detailed financial documentation is provided.

items.title: Historic Property Demolition Delay Increase
items.summary: Approved increasing the historic demolition delay from six months to a period of one to two years and referred the matter to the Zoning and Ordinance subcommittee to draft the ordinance change.

items.title: Utility Trench Identification System
items.summary: Approved a resolution to implement a color-coded trench identification system to hold public utilities and contractors accountable for road restoration work.

items.title: Diversification of Park Recreational Amenities
items.summary: Approved a resolution for the Park Commission to explore expanding park offerings to include amenities like bocce courts, art installations, and body-weight exercise equipment.

items.title: Arlington Street Speed Limit Enforcement
items.summary: Approved requesting the police department increase visibility and enforcement of speed limits on Arlington Street during weekday rush hours.

items.title: Lincoln Road Utility Work Maintenance
items.summary: Approved requiring utility contractors on Lincoln Road to perform weekly street sweeping and remove all equipment and debris during non-working periods.

items.title: Fiscal Year 2016 End-of-Year Budget Transfers
items.summary: Tabled a request to transfer $1,112,000 to cover various departmental deficits after councilors demanded line-item expenditure reports and monthly budget-to-actual updates.

items.title: Pedestrian Crossing Repair and State Delegation Contact
items.summary: Approved contacting the state delegation to request repairs for a pedestrian crossing sign at the intersection of Route 16 and Boston Avenue.

items.title: Locust Street Project Judicial Appeal
items.summary: Approved filing an appeal in Land Court against the Board of Appeals decision regarding the Locust Street development project.

items.title: Inquiry into Late-Night Road Paving
items.summary: Approved requesting reports from the engineering and public works departments regarding unannounced road work performed at 11:00 PM near Duggar Park.

items.title: Public Participation on Parking and Infrastructure
items.summary: Residents criticized the city's parking ticket enforcement practices and the lack of road maintenance on Evans and Swan Streets.

items.title: Petitions for Evans Street and Swan Street Repairs
items.summary: The council reviewed petitions for critical road repairs on Evans and Swan Streets; Councilor Knight reported that a contract for Evans Street water infrastructure work is currently moving through the award process.

items.title: Approval of Minutes and Adjournment
items.summary: Approved the minutes for May 31, 2016, and tabled the records of June 14, 2016.
